source: Chief Architect X18 Tutorial Guide, Floor Plan Tutorials, pages 105-126

steps.step: Pin CHIC COTTAGE-CURRENT in the Dashboard's recent documents
steps.gap: No Dashboard; pin the plan in File > Recent Files instead. Row: UI-30

steps.step: Deck Railing, Railing and Half Wall defaults (5 1/2" capped posts, 1 1/4" square balusters 5" OC, white; half wall Siding-6 over Stone-6 at 20", 16" upper)
steps.gap: No separate Deck Railing / Railing / Half Wall defaults or a Half Wall tool; draw walls and set each one's height (and pony) in its specification. Row: WL-29

steps.step: Porch: two half walls enclosing the area outside the front door, the front one 8' from the entry wall, the left one in line with the Dining/Foyer wall
Make the new room a Porch
(The basement doesn't extend under the porch)
Deck room defaults: 1" planks with 1/4" gaps; deck post footings 30" deep
steps.gap: Deck defaults (planks, footing depth) live on each deck and are set below. Row: SITE-26

steps.step: Deck at the back: three deck railings enclosing a deck room, 36" in from each side wall and 8' deep
(Plank thickness 1", gap 1/4", footings 30" deep)
(In Chief the deck is a room drawn with Deck Railings)
steps.gap: Decks are drawn with the Deck tool as one object, not as a room enclosed by deck railings. Row: SITE-26

steps.step: Move the three automatic dimensions out of the deck (Transform/Replicate, 8' up); they stop refreshing
steps.gap: Automatic dimensions can't be moved or edited without being rebuilt. Row: DIM-27

steps.step: Add and remove extension lines; extend a dimension with Add Segments
steps.gap: No extension-line or add-segment handles on dimensions. Row: DIM-28

steps.step: Terrain perimeter, 60' deep, centred on the house's right side; surface 28" below the subfloor at the Garage's front corner
(Surface at the reference point: -28")
(Terrain elevation reference point dragged to the Garage corner)
steps.gap: No terrain reference point; the base elevation is the terrain's height everywhere without elevation data. Row: SITE-27

steps.step: Turn on the Footings, Deck Post layer
steps.gap: Deck post footings have no layer of their own. Row: SITE-26

steps.step: Porch stem walls on Floor 0 under the porch walls, 37 1/2" high, no floor under the porch room
steps.gap: No Straight Foundation Wall tool or room stem-wall height; draw walls on the Foundation floor and set their height. Row: FD-09

steps.step: Exterior stair defaults (capped newels 5 1/2" x 44", white rails, redwood treads, treated stringers)
steps.gap: Stair defaults have no newel style or per-part materials. Row: ST-12

steps.step: Deck stairs: outside the left deck railing, going down to the terrain (Open Object > Down to grade); 5' wide with railings both sides. The deck railing opens where they meet it
(Open the stair: tick Down to grade)
Concrete porch stairs, 6' wide, centred on the porch's front, down to grade with no stringers (solid)
(Open the stair: tick Down to grade, untick Stringers)
(Concrete material on the porch stairs; the stairs opening the porch's front half wall)
steps.gap: Stairs have one material and only open deck railings; break the half wall (Add Break) and delete the piece in front of the stairs. Rows: ST-12, ST-20

steps.step: Notes: 'CONCRETE STEPS TO GRADE', 'FRAMED STEPS TO GRADE', and numbered note 'EXTERIOR LANDING 36" MINIMUM IN DIRECTION OF TRAVEL' (copied to both stairs)

commands.text: EXTERIOR LANDING 36" MINIMUM IN DIRECTION OF TRAVEL

steps.step: (Numbered note and its copy)
Reorder the Note Schedule by dragging rows; Move Up/Down in Schedule buttons
steps.gap: Schedule rows can't be reordered. Row: EST-28

steps.step: Save a copy; organise the archive plans in a Project Browser folder
